$comment: Single source of truth for WP Rig theme-dev paradigms. The ACTIVE theme type is set in config/config.default.json under theme.themeType (one-line change to alter the default) and can be overridden in config/config.json or config/config.local.json. Each feature paradigm tag maps to the theme types where that feature is enabled. Block-based features are active in both 'universal' and 'block-based' (hybrid themes include blocks); they never ship in the 'classic' core.
